messages:
jamal: quick check — i'm going to add subnet tagging for egress-affinity so TGW attachment routing picks AZ-local nat gateways. planning to push a small terraform change in infra-networking. any obvious gotchas?

mira: SGTM, just make sure the tag key matches the tgw routing policy we use (egress-affinity = <az>-nat). otherwise route selection won't match.

jamal: thanks — current plan is to add tags in modules/subnet/main.tf like:
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "this" {
  # ...
  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    "redwood:egress-affinity" = var.az_label,
  })
}
```
will also add a small migration to tag existing subnets.

alex: are you tagging private subnets only? we shouldn't tag public ones or the autoscaling subnets used by k8s nodegroups.

jamal: correct — only private subnets. will add a filter in the module to only tag if var.map_public_ip_on_launch == false.

sam: minor thing — the TGW route table lookup lambda expects tags on subnet resource, but if you tag via tf resource "aws_subnet" vs aws_subnet_tag resource, the timing in apply might create a race where the lambda runs before tags exist. we hit this during the last rollout.

mira: good catch. we solved that before by forcing create_before_destroy and adding an explicit null_resource local-exec that calls aws ec2 create-tags for the subnet id after apply (ugly but reliable). example:
```hcl
resource "null_resource" "post_tag" {
  triggers = { id = aws_subnet.this.id }
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = "aws ec2 create-tags --resources ${aws_subnet.this.id} --tags Key=redwood:egress-affinity,Value=${var.az_label}"
  }
}
```
could also consider moving the lambda to react to tag creation instead of rely on tags being present at apply time.

jamal: hmm ok. prefer to avoid null_resource unless necessary. @alex any appetite to make the lambda resilient to eventual consistency (re-check tags up to N times)?

alex: yes i can add retry/backoff in the lambda and have it ignore missing tags for the first 5 minutes, re-evaluate every 30s. that'll reduce the urgency for the tf hack.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline check: infra-networking plan for branch jamal/egress-tags -> 2 diffs flagged (subnet tags added). no drift detected.

sam: also remember route table associations — if you rely on subnet tags for TGW routing, ensure the route propagation rule uses filters against the tag key we pick. otherwise TGW might not pick the intended attachment.

jamal: noted. i'll update tgw-routing lambda + add tests in terraform plan to assert tag present on newly-created private subnets. i'll open a PR in ~30m. thanks all.

mira: optional: add an integration smoke test that spins up a tiny subnet and validates traffic egress goes via AZ-local nat. saved us before.

jamal: good idea — will add a tiny terratest or pytest-aws check in the pr.

alex: ping me in the PR for the lambda changes.

jamal: will do. cc @ci-bot run full plan & test when PR opens :thumbsup:
